alt: 買菜的人一心伸手撿地上一枚小硬幣，卻讓手臂上的大籃子傾倒，許多雞蛋和水果掉落損壞，孩子急忙提醒。
scene_prompt: Modern neighborhood market walkway. A shopper already carrying a large basket full of eggs and ripe fruit greedily stretches far down to grab a single tiny plain coin on pavement, eyes fixed eagerly on small coin, ignoring tipped basket on other arm. Many eggs and soft fruit spill from basket and break or get squashed on ground, far greater loss than coin gained. Child beside him points anxiously at falling groceries. Show the causal moment: one hand pinches tiny coin just above ground, other arm tilts basket unwisely, eggs visibly falling under gravity; no traffic danger, sharp glass or injury. Emphasize unnecessary eagerness for tiny extra gain causing large loss. Person not portrayed as hungry poor or needing coin. Natural exactly two arms and five fingers, basket handle weight credible, grounded feet, realistic eggs shells safe.
